families.name: spindle_http_requests_total
families.summary: Requests the run answered outside /__spindle/, by method, route template, operation, kind, class and status class; an unrouted request has an empty route, operation and kind.

families.name: spindle_http_request_duration_seconds
families.summary: From a request's head read to its answer handed back, on the listener thread, for every request counted by spindle_http_requests_total.

families.name: spindle_commands_total
families.summary: Commands executed, by the declared outcome the model selected.

families.name: spindle_command_failures_total
families.summary: Commands the kernel did not execute, by why.

families.name: spindle_command_duration_seconds
families.summary: How long the kernel took to execute a command.

families.name: spindle_bindings_total
families.summary: Envelopes of an event binding, by what happened to each: sent, delivered, redelivered or dropped, at the component that measured it.

families.name: spindle_binding_retries_total
families.summary: Invocations of a retrying binding's command, attempted or exhausted.

families.name: spindle_timer_ticks_total
families.summary: Ticks of a periodic binding, fired, late or dropped.

families.name: spindle_entity_rows
families.summary: Rows each entity holds now, kept from the writes this process lands and taken once from its store when the store opens; falls on a reset.

families.name: spindle_resets_total
families.summary: Resets of the run's stores through POST /api/reset.

families.name: spindle_external_causes_total
families.summary: External causes a served command asked about, by what answered each: world, file, default, call or unanswered.
